messages.author: d00150675c4b4e89
messages.subject: Shiny on Mac
parts: I have several machines with various distros of linux and all of them work well with shiny both locally and with my shiny server. I just inherited a MacBook Pro and here is the problem: shiny graphs and charts don't render in FIrefox locally. They render when I point my Firefox browser to my shiny server but not when I try to run applications (even the examples) locally. I launched R through both R Studio and through a shell window with the same result. The kicker is that when I launch R using sudo, the graphs render but they pop up in Safari. It seems like a configuration problem. Does anyone know which file in Mac (Mountain Lion) this involves? I'm new to OSX. It's really to much of a problem as I can always start R in sudo but I'm curious to know what is going on here. Thanks.
